Our Story

Food that brings people together

We believe the best meals happen outside — where laughter carries on the breeze and every table becomes a memory worth keeping. The Open Table has been crafting exceptional outdoor dining experiences for over eight years, turning any space into a venue worth remembering.

From intimate garden lunches to large corporate galas, our team handles everything: setup, staffing, bespoke menus, and seamless service — so you can enjoy the moment alongside your guests.
